verdict.rationale: Gusto's core payroll platform is closed-source SaaS with no evidence of open-licensed source for the product itself, but the company does ship an official companion CLI (gusto-cli) publicly on GitHub under an Apache-2.0 license, which is inspectable source code. This only covers a peripheral developer tool, not the actual payroll application/backend. Missing for 10: open-licensed source for the core Gusto product/platform, any indication the main service's codebase is available, independent confirmation of license terms beyond the repo listing.
